C1271.title: Fortinet FortiCloud SSO Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
C1271.summary: An SSO authentication bypass vulnerability exists in Fortinet FortiGate devices due to missing session validation logic in FortiCloud SSO. Attackers can leverage a legitimate FortiCloud account to bypass authentication and log into other users' devices. The vulnerability has a severity score of 9.8, and in-the-wild exploitation has been observed targeting fully patched appliances.
